articles.title: Air Pollution Risk During Thanksgiving Cooking Highlighted by Experts
articles.summary: Cooking on Thanksgiving can create an environment similar to a smoggy day due to emissions from food being prepared at home.
articles.content: A Thanksgiving meal may be a time for family and friends to gather, but it also poses an unexpected threat: indoor air pollution caused by cooking emissions. According to Virginia Tech air quality expert Linsey Marr, cooking on Thanksgiving can create an environment similar to a smoggy day, but instead of coming from industry and vehicles, it originates from the food being prepared in our own homes. Marr's warning highlights the often-overlooked issue of indoor air pollution during holiday meals. Research led by Marina Vance, a Virginia Tech alumna, has found that cooking Thanksgiving dinner can lead to significant levels of particulate matter in the air. These particles are generated when oils and fats released from food as it heats up condense into tiny airborne particles that can persist indoors. The majority of these emissions come from stovetop or oven cooking, where food is heated and oils and fats are released into the air. When cooking Thanksgiving dinner, it's not just the food that can be a concern for indoor air quality. The use of natural gas appliances in the kitchen can also contribute to the problem, as they generate particles and nitrogen dioxide, a gaseous pollutant. At high concentrations, this type of indoor air pollution can cause respiratory irritation, such as coughing and shortness of breath. This makes it essential for hosts to monitor air quality during extended cooking sessions like those that occur on holidays. To minimize the issue, there are some simple steps that can be taken. To minimize indoor air quality problems during Thanksgiving cooking, one simple yet effective solution is to introduce fresh air into the home. This can be achieved by opening windows if the weather permits, allowing a gentle breeze to circulate and dilute airborne pollutants. A portable air purifier placed in or near the kitchen can also help remove airborne particles and improve indoor air quality during periods of heavy cooking. By doing so, the focus can remain on enjoying the holiday rather than worrying about indoor air pollution. By implementing these simple measures, homeowners can significantly reduce the risk of poor indoor air quality associated with cooking Thanksgiving dinner. articles.title: Simulation Study Aims to Improve 3D-Printed Food Consistency
articles.summary: Researchers from two Dutch universities have conducted a simulation study on food inks used in 3D printing, aiming to provide valuable insights for engineers designing better food printers and inks.
articles.content: Researchers have been exploring ways to create a futuristic food production system that can print any dish imaginable. This concept is reminiscent of the "replicator technology found in science fiction shows like Star Trek, but scientists are working towards making it a reality. The potential applications of food printing extend beyond novelty treats for restaurants, with the possibility of creating customized meals for patients with specific dietary needs. Food printing can be tailored to meet exact nutritional requirements and provide specific textures that may aid in recovery or alleviate certain conditions. However, developing effective 3D-printed foods requires a deep understanding of how the materials used for printing behave under different conditions. The characteristics of food-based inks and pastes are often unpredictable, making it difficult to ensure consistent results when using them with 3D printers. To address this issue, researchers from two Dutch universities have conducted a simulation study published in Physics of Fluids. By modeling the behavior of food inks as they pass through a printer's nozzle, these scientists aim to provide valuable insights for engineers designing better food printers and inks. The goal is to make 3D printing a viable option for widespread use in various industries, including healthcare, where customized meals can be created to meet specific needs. The transition from solid to liquid is a crucial aspect of food inks used in 3D printing, and researchers have been working to develop accurate models that can capture this behavior. Capturing the extrudability" of food inks - their ability to flow through printer nozzles with ease - is key to simulating their performance. This complex behavior has proven challenging to measure and model accurately, but a research group has made significant progress in developing a computational model that can represent it. To test its model, the team implemented it into an extrusion process simulation, which predicted the force required to push ink through a syringe. The researchers then compared these predictions against experimental measurements of the extrusion force for two types of food ink: one rich in protein and another composed mainly of fiber. The results showed that the model accurately predicted the behavior of the protein-rich ink, but overestimated the extrusion force for the fiber-based ink. This discrepancy may be due to the presence of water in the ink, which coats the nozzle walls and causes the ink to slide during the extrusion process. Further investigation is needed to refine the model and account for the unique properties of different food inks, including the effect of water on their behavior. The next step for the researchers is to refine their model by taking into account the complexities introduced by wall sliding, as well as the changes in material properties over time. According to Bugday, this work will enable engineers to design more effective nozzles, establish safe operating limits for equipment, and develop ink formulations tailored to specific machinery requirements and customer specifications. This comprehensive tool is expected to aid groups seeking to create better 3D-printed food by streamlining the development process. The research aims to provide a valuable resource for those working in the field of 3D printing of food, ultimately contributing to the advancement of this innovative technology. In essence, a balanced gut microbiome will be considered a benchmark for overall health, much like these other vital signs. Personalized nutrition will soon replace generic dietary advice, with AI-powered recommendations tailored to each person's unique gut microbiome, genetic profile, metabolism, immune system, and lifestyle. This approach aims to prevent or control most long-term conditions through early biological monitoring and targeted nutritional interventions. The emphasis on prevention as the greatest medical breakthrough underscores the significance of this shift in focus. By addressing underlying causes of illness rather than just treating symptoms, healthcare professionals can help individuals maintain optimal health for longer periods. As a result, children will grow up with healthier gut microbiomes, reducing their risk of developing chronic diseases later in life. This, in turn, will enable future generations to explore and inhabit space without compromising their well-being. articles.title: iOS Users Can Now Sideload Apps with Apple's Free Developer Account
articles.summary: Apple has opened up to alternative app stores and payment methods due to regulatory changes in regions like the European Union and Japan.
articles.content: Apple has finally opened up to alternative app stores and payment methods, a move driven by regulatory changes in regions like the European Union and Japan. This shift has created new possibilities for users worldwide, including those in the US who can now sideload iOS apps with the right tools. In countries where alternative app marketplaces are available, downloading apps outside of the App Store is relatively straightforward. However, for those in the US, a workaround exists through Apple's free Developer account. This account allows users to sign and install apps from outside the App Store for development purposes, providing a way to sideload compatible IPA files. The process involves using tools like AltStore Classic or Sideloadly to take advantage of the free Developer account. These tools enable users to install compatible IPA files, which are essentially iOS app packages. This workaround has become increasingly popular among those looking to try out specific apps not available on the App Store. While this option is available in the US, it's essential to note that there are limitations and drawbacks. Apps signed with a free account expire after seven days, requiring re-signing, and users can only sideload three apps at a time. Despite these constraints, it remains an option for those seeking alternative iOS apps. To take advantage of this workaround, individuals must first obtain a free Apple Developer account. This will grant them access to sign and install apps from outside the App Store, paving the way for sideloading compatible IPA files with tools like AltStore Classic or Sideloadly. To sideload apps on iOS without restrictions, users have several options for installing AltStore, a tool that allows them to install IPA files. There are two versions of AltStore: PAL and Classic. The PAL version is available in regions where Apple has been forced to allow sideloading, while the Classic version can be installed anywhere but requires a companion desktop app called AltServer. AltServer is a crucial component for installing AltStore Classic, which is available for both Windows and macOS operating systems. On Windows, users need to ensure that iTunes and iCloud are installed from Apple's official website, rather than the Microsoft Store. This ensures compatibility with AltServer. Before proceeding with the installation process, users must plug their iPhone into a Mac or PC using a cable, unlock it, and confirm they trust the computer. Next, they should turn on Wi-Fi Sync for the device in iTunes or Finder if necessary. Once this is done, users can click the AltServer icon to initiate the installation of AltStore. Now that AltServer is running, users can select Install AltStore and choose their device from a list. The process will prompt them to sign into their Apple Developer account, which may require retrieving forgotten credentials by changing their Apple Account password. After signing in, users must navigate to Settings > General > VPN & Device Management and mark their Apple Developer account as trusted. To access additional external sources through AltStore, users must navigate to the app's interface and explore its features. This allows for the installation of third-party apps that may not be available on the App Store. Once an IPA file is obtained from another source, it can be opened in Files and shared with AltStore, which will then identify and sideload the app. AltServer must be running on a computer while installing apps through this method, either connected to the iPhone or iPad via cable or part of the same Wi-Fi network. Having a paid Apple Developer account significantly increases the number of apps that can be sideloaded in this manner. A more convenient option for sideloading without relying heavily on a computer is offered by AltStore itself. In the AltStore Classic app, users must access Settings and sign into their Apple Developer account before proceeding to set up Remote AltServer according to the in-app instructions. The necessary step of setting up LocalDevVPN on the iOS device becomes apparent only after attempting to connect remotely; without it active, the connection will fail. Once all prerequisites are met, however, users can sideload apps from AltStore even when a computer is not nearby. Users have another option available to them: SideStore, which functions similarly to AltStore but offers a more streamlined experience. This is possible due to its ability to bypass the need for a computer altogether, thanks to the use of the SideInstaller app. For users in the EU, Japan or Brazil, these workarounds are unnecessary, as sideloading apps can be done with ease through an app marketplace website, requiring only a few simple steps: navigating to the site, clicking install and then granting permission for the app to run in Settings. articles.title: Quantifying Key Component Proteins within Kinetochore Complex in Living Cells Achieved by Researchers
articles.summary: A major breakthrough has been achieved by researchers at the University of Osaka who have successfully quantified the number of key component proteins within the kinetochore complex in...
articles.content: A major breakthrough has been achieved by researchers at the University of Osaka who have successfully quantified the number of key component proteins within the kinetochore complex in living cells. This achievement has been published in the Journal of Cell Biology and is set to revolutionize our understanding of how these proteins work together. The kinetochore, a protein structure critical for life and growth, enables the accurate division of genetic material into two daughter cells. However, challenges have long hindered researchers from grasping the molecular organization of this complex within living cells. To rectify this, an improved fluorescence-based method has been developed to count these proteins in real-time. As a cell prepares to divide into two, its genetic material is duplicated and paired at the centromere region. The kinetochore assembles at this precise location and serves as the attachment point for chromosomes to link with the spindle structure running throughout the cell. This intricate process ensures that each new cell receives an accurate copy of the genetic material. The failure of chromosomes to attach accurately to the spindle can result in errors linked to various diseases, making the accurate division of genetic material a critical aspect of life and growth. To address this issue, researchers have been working tirelessly to develop methods for measuring the molecular organization of the kinetochore within living cells. In mitotic chicken DT40 cells, researchers employed fluorescence correlation spectroscopy-calibrated molecular counting to study the kinetochore complex. The kinetochore consists of two main protein networks: the CCAN forming the inner kinetochore and the KMN forming the outer kinetochore. Among the CCAN proteins measured, CENP-C was found to be present at a significantly higher copy number than the others. This discrepancy in copy numbers highlights the complexity of the kinetochore's molecular organization. The attachment mechanism between the inner and outer kinetochore complexes involves two redundant binding sites on CENP-C and another CCAN protein, CENP-T. Both these proteins have specific binding sites for the Mis12C protein complex. The presence of these binding sites ensures a secure attachment between the two complexes. Researchers found that removing one of the Mis12C binding sites from either CENP-C or CENP-T does not impede the cell's ability to divide successfully. In fact, sufficient Mis12C can still bind to the other CENP protein, allowing for the recruitment of KMN components and maintaining the integrity of the division process. The research team found that a minimum of 15 molecules of Mis12C and over 30 molecules of Ndc80C are necessary for accurate cell division to occur. According to senior author Tatsuo Fukagawa, the high number of Ndc80C molecules provides a stable platform for attachment to microtubules, with an estimated 8-10 molecules per microtubule. This suggests that sufficient quantities of these proteins are crucial for maintaining the integrity of the cell division process. The study sheds new light on the complex process of creating structures essential for accurate cell division, a fundamental aspect of cellular growth and development. articles.title: Tiffany Howell Brings Theatrical Vision to Art Basel Kitchen Installation
articles.summary: Designers Tiffany Howell brought her unique vision to a kitchen installation at Art Basel in Miami, commissioned by Miele.
articles.content: Tiffany Howell, a designer known for her theatrical approach to interior design, has brought her unique vision to a kitchen installation at Art Basel in Miami. The project, commissioned by Miele, offered her a chance to rethink the traditional concept of a kitchen and turn it into a living work of art. Howell's inspiration for this project drew from various sources including film, fashion, and music, which she believes are just as essential as decorative art when designing a home. She aimed to create an immersive experience that engages all senses by combining texture, sound, scent, light, and form in a harmonious way. The installation features black cabinetry adorned with blossoming branches and birds in vibrant colors, giving the kitchen an elevated sense of sensuality. According to Howell, she wanted to capture a romantic quality often associated with the home's heart, the kitchen, by transforming it into an extraordinary space that evokes deep emotions. Howell considers the kitchen as one of the most intimate rooms in the house and has aimed to infuse it with a sense of romance by pushing beyond conventional design boundaries. The kitchen design is influenced by Tiffany Howell's fascination with 1920s chinoiserie furniture and fashion, reinterpreted through a glamorous Los Angeles lens. This aesthetic is reflected in the cabinets, which bring a touch of vintage sophistication to the space. The California-inspired focus on bringing the outdoors in is also evident. To achieve this effect, the grand conservatory space has been designed to harness natural light, with the added allure of jasmine wafting through the air. According to Howell, her goal was to create a kitchen that engages all the senses. This immersive experience transforms raw space into lived emotion by incorporating sensory details that are integral to the design. The Miele appliances serve as elegant focal points in the room, much like fine jewelry adds sparkle to an outfit. In Howell's view, the kitchen is not just for cooking but also a versatile space where one can relax, read, or write. The seamless integration of high-tech appliances has become a hallmark of sophisticated kitchen design. Miele's Built-In Coffee System and wine cooler are prime examples, blending into their surroundings to create a harmonious balance between form and function. In this context, the line between heirloom design and cutting-edge technology blurs, yielding a cohesive look that is both timeless and modern. The 36” Full Surface Induction Cooktop is a testament to this fusion, with its frameless, flush design disappearing into the dark-veined countertop like a well-integrated piece of furniture. The cooktop's Intelligent Pan Recognition and SmartSelect White controls allow for effortless cooking, as power settings can be seamlessly adjusted according to the pans' location. This intuitive interface transforms the cooking experience into a tactile ritual that engages the senses rather than disrupting them. On the same wall, the 30” Handleless Combi-Steam Oven XXL boasts DualSteam technology and a black glass façade that resembles a framed panel or window. As steam is emitted, it produces ASMR sounds that further enhance the sensory experience, creating an immersive cooking environment. The seamless integration of appliances into the kitchen design creates a harmonious and artful space. Howell's innovative approach to concealing technology in the 42" French Door Refrigerator showcases her unique style, blending functionality with decorative flair. The elongated custom handles and dark lacquered paneled front mirror the floral chinoiserie motifs, transforming an ordinary appliance into a piece of artistic expression. By harmonizing every aspect of the kitchen, sight, surface, scent, and sound, Howell crafts a restorative environment that invites intimacy and slowness. This thoughtful design encourages technology to promote lightness and free up time for more meaningful experiences. articles.title: Cross-border Payments Simplified with New Stablecoin Ecosystem
articles.summary: Codex has secured $30 million in funding through a Series A round, enabling it to support businesses in sending money across borders and exchanging currencies.
articles.content: A crucial challenge faced by businesses worldwide is facilitating cross-border payments. Stablecoins can simplify this process, but many companies lack the necessary infrastructure to utilize them effectively. This gap in market access has led Codex to identify a significant opportunity. The Delaware-based startup recently announced it had secured $30 million in funding through a Series A round. This investment will enable Codex to support businesses in sending money across borders and exchanging currencies, eliminating the need for upfront deposits. By doing so, the company aims to establish itself as a key player in the global market. "We help people convert money into whatever form they want and give it to whoever they want, wherever they want," Haonan Li, Codex's cofounder and CEO, explained. His words highlight the complexity of cross-border transactions, particularly in regions where such operations are often hindered by restrictive systems. The company plans to utilize a portion of the funding to further automate its foreign-exchange platform. AI agents will play a central role in this endeavor, streamlining the process while keeping costs manageable as transaction volumes increase. Codex, a Pantera-backed startup, has secured $30 million in funding to create a stablecoin-based ecosystem linking Asia to global markets. This significant investment comes at a post-money valuation of $130 million, with notable investors participating including Dragonfly and Coinbase Ventures, who also contributed to Codex's earlier seed round led by Dragonfly alongside Circle Ventures, Cumberland, and Wintermute. The rising popularity of stablecoins as a lifeline in countries plagued by inflation or capital controls has been a defining trend in the cryptocurrency space. Payments made with these digital currencies have reached a staggering $401 billion within the first eight months of 2026, representing a 42% year-over-year increase. As Franklin Bi noted, building Codex is crucial for addressing the fragmented nature of stablecoin issuance following its massive growth. The founders of Codex saw an opportunity to bridge the gap between traditional financial networks and those excluded from them through stablecoins. Codex was founded in 2024 by a team that had come together organically, with Li and Victor Yaw meeting over a decade ago during infantry officer candidate school in Singapore's military. Momo Ong joined the team after initially advising them, bringing his expertise to the company. This diverse group of individuals brought their unique perspectives to build Codex. The company has since expanded its reach across continents, establishing offices in key locations such as London, Hong Kong, New York, and San Francisco. As Li noted, "the journey stretched from the jungles of Brunei to the skyscrapers of New York." articles.title: Nvidia Forms National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
articles.summary: The committee is seen as an attempt by Nvidia to boost transparency and accountability in light of growing concerns over its role in national security.
articles.content: Nvidia has formed a high-level committee to oversee its national security and export control practices following a recent scandal surrounding its former CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affairs. The new National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee is seen as an attempt by the US tech giant to boost transparency and accountability in light of growing concerns over its role in national security. The company has been under intense scrutiny after it emerged that Huang had engaged in personal relationships with individuals linked to foreign governments, including one suspected of spying for China. The scandal has sent shockwaves through the market, wiping hundreds of billions of dollars off Nvidia's valuation and casting a shadow over its reputation as the world's leading AI chipmaker. The company's investors are now closely watching how it responds to these revelations, with many calling for greater oversight and regulation in the industry. Nvidia has appointed a seasoned expert, Suzanne Nora Johnson, a former vice chair at Goldman Sachs, to chair the new committee. She will be joined by other directors Stephen Neal, a veteran law firm CEO, and John Dabiri, an aeronautics professor at Caltech, as well as independent experts in national security and trade compliance. The committee will meet regularly, with a minimum of one meeting every quarter, to review Nvidia's export control practices and ensure that its products are not being used for malicious purposes. The new committee will oversee Nvidia's National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team, which are currently responsible for ensuring compliance with export control regulations. According to Board Chair Harvey Jones, Nvidia is committed to working collaboratively with government partners and industry stakeholders to establish a robust framework that balances national security concerns with the need for technological innovation. This statement reflects the company's efforts to address growing scrutiny over its business practices. The timing of the announcement raises questions about the motivations behind Nvidia's decision, particularly given the recent controversy surrounding CEO Jensen Huang's abrupt departure from the company. While the company has not explicitly linked the committee's establishment to these events, the coincidence is striking. Nvidia's stock price has taken a hit in recent weeks, falling by nearly 28% over the past month ahead of its third-quarter earnings release. The announcement came just hours before the company published its quarterly results, sparking speculation about the potential impact on investor confidence. The controversy surrounding Nvidia's former CEO has led to a significant development in the company's operations. A national security committee has been formed at Nvidia, following the resignation of its former CEO, who admitted to extramarital affairs and sparked allegations of compromising US export controls. articles.title: Google Maps offers advanced features for users
articles.summary: Users can customize Google Maps settings to suit their vehicle and route preferences.
articles.content: Google Maps offers a wealth of features that go beyond simply getting from point A to point B. While many users stick to the basics, there are hidden tools within the app that can make it even more useful and personalized. To start with, Google Maps allows users to specify their car's type, which is not just about the make and model but also its engine type. This information can be crucial in tailoring routing decisions to suit a particular vehicle's needs, taking into account factors such as fuel efficiency or electric range. Users who want to get the most out of Google Maps should explore its various settings, including those related to route planning and reminders. By adjusting these settings, users can ensure that their music remains uninterrupted while still receiving step-by-step instructions for navigation. One particularly useful feature within Google Maps is the ability to set reminders for when it's time to leave a destination. This simple yet practical tool can help users avoid last-minute scrambles or oversights, especially during busy commutes. Customizing settings such as route planning and car type can also unlock more detailed recommendations from Google Maps. By specifying preferences like traffic avoidance or fuel efficiency, users can receive tailored suggestions that cater to their unique needs and circumstances. Google Maps offers a feature for EV and plug-in hybrid owners to specify their car's charging requirements, allowing the app to surface compatible charging stations along routes. This setting can be found in the app's settings under "Your vehicles. By indicating the type of plug or adapter needed, users can ensure they don't waste time searching for suitable charging points. Route preferences are another important consideration when using Google Maps. Users can toggle options to avoid tolls, ferries, and even highways, making it easier to take the scenic route or save money on fuel costs. To access these settings, navigate to Navigation in the app's settings, where all toggles are found under Route options. Setting up custom navigation preferences can also save time in the long run. Users can set their home address within the app, allowing them to jump straight to custom directions with a single tap. For those with enabled Gemini assistants, users can even use voice commands like navigate home to set routes. Google Maps' estimated arrival times are often spot on, taking into account factors such as traffic and chosen route. While accidents may occasionally cause delays, it's usually the case that users left their homes late in accordance with their predicted arrival time. This level of accuracy is a testament to Google Maps' capabilities in estimating travel times. By specifying preferences like traffic avoidance or fuel efficiency, users can receive tailored suggestions that cater to their unique needs and circumstances. Using Google Maps on your iPhone can also help you avoid lateness by sending you a reminder when it's time to leave for an appointment. This is achieved through the app's Set a reminder to leave feature, which allows users to set an arrive-by or leave-by time for their destination under Directions > transportation mode. Once this is done, tapping the three-dot menu and selecting Set a reminder to leave > Depart or Arrive > setting the desired time will send you a notification when it's time to head out. This feature can be particularly useful in busy cities where traffic conditions can change dramatically between different days of the week. For individuals with packed schedules, constantly checking the app for updates is no longer necessary thanks to these reminders. They work equally well for those planning on using public transport or navigating through unfamiliar areas. Planning a trip requires considering various factors such as traffic and road conditions. Google Maps offers users the ability to specify preferences like avoiding traffic or prioritizing fuel efficiency, which tailors suggestions based on their unique needs and circumstances. Users can also customize their in-app experience by adjusting settings that affect how they receive information while navigating. One such setting involves controlling whether voice guidance is played over Bluetooth or not, allowing for a smoother and more enjoyable ride. Silencing Google Maps' voice guidance can be achieved by turning off the Play voice over Bluetooth" option within Settings > Navigation on Android devices. This small adjustment makes a significant difference in reducing distractions while driving, especially in urban environments where frequent turns are necessary. The process of silencing voice guidance is straightforward and requires minimal effort. By simply accessing your profile and navigating to Settings > Navigation, users can toggle off the feature that plays voice instructions over Bluetooth speakers. This change allows for a more enjoyable listening experience during long drives. This setting's toggle is located under Sound & Voice in the Navigation menu, making it easily accessible whenever needed. When using Google Maps on Android Auto while parked, drivers have access to a convenient feature that allows them to play games directly on their screen. This setting enables users to pass the time during waiting periods, such as when picking up kids from practice or taking a break at a rest stop, making the experience more enjoyable. articles.title: Iran Denies Allegations of Dirty Bomb Attack on Washington DC
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump's administration is taking the threat seriously and warned Iran that it would face severe consequences if proven true.
articles.content: Iran has denied allegations of planning a "dirty bomb attack on Washington DC after a CNN report sparked concerns about potential Iranian aggression. US President Donald Trump has confirmed that his administration is taking the threat seriously and warned Iran that it would face severe consequences if proven true. According to multiple US intelligence sources cited by CNN, Iran is allegedly developing plans to target senior Trump administration officials with either a dirty bomb or a chemical weapon in Washington DC. The report also claims that Iranian chatter has been picked up indicating the country's possession of pre-positioned nuclear materials within its territory and possibly even inside the United States. Iran has dismissed the CNN report, stating that it does not acknowledge any involvement in planning such an attack. Iran's Foreign Ministry has condemned a recent report alleging that the country is planning to launch a dirty bomb attack on Washington. The statement comes as tensions between Iran and its adversaries continue to escalate. Esmail Baghaei, the Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson, described the report as a malicious campaign aimed at creating propaganda. He accused those who initiated aggression against Iran of trying to justify further attacks by spreading baseless allegations through the media. According to him, this is part of a larger effort to manufacture a veneer of legitimacy for their actions. Baghaei specifically mentioned CNN's reporting on the alleged dirty bomb plot" and The New York Times without referencing any specific article or report from that publication. He accused both US and Israeli forces of carrying out attacks on water storage reservoirs during recent military operations. This comes as negotiations to end the fighting between Iran, the US, and Israel have stalled. The Iran war, sparked by US and Israeli strikes on February 28, continues with both sides holding off from major attacks due to elections in their respective countries. Meanwhile, Tehran has asserted control over the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial transit point for global oil and natural gas supplies. However, there are frequent reports of ships hitting mines in parts of the strait that Iran considers unauthorized for passage. The US Navy has been enforcing its own blockade of Iranian vessels in the Persian Gulf, which has led to increased tensions in the region. In recent times, American warships have been escorting tankers through the strait as a precautionary measure to prevent any potential attacks on these vessels. A fragile peace process between the US and Iran has been ongoing, with Pakistan serving as a mediator in April. However, talks failed to yield a conclusive outcome. The international community is urging restraint from all parties involved, with Qatar calling for calm to avoid escalating tensions that could undermine ongoing negotiation efforts.
